Anurag Jain Appointed CEO of NITI Aayog

Anurag Jain has assumed the position of Chief Executive Officer (CEO) at NITI Aayog. His tenure as CEO is expected to be for two years. Jain's appointment marks a significant administrative change at the policy think tank.
